description: Get details for a Hugging Face model, dataset, or space repository.

repo_id.description: The repository identifier (e.g. 'owner/name') to retrieve details for.

repo_type.description: Optional repository type selecting the namespace: 'models', 'datasets', or 'spaces' (default 'models'; singular forms are also accepted).

revision.description: Optional revision (branch, tag, or commit) to query for this repository.

name: hub_repo_details
